India A swiftly chased down the set target of 250 runs in a mere 14.2 overs, showcasing their dominance. UAE's Harpreet Singh Bhatia made notable contributions with his century, which helped to secure a formidable score of 249.

articles.title: 52-ball double hundred! Vaibhav Sooryavanshi smashes world record with 204
articles.description: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi stunned the cricketing world by setting a new benchmark with the fastest double century in List A cricket, achieving the milestone in a mere 52 balls. During the ACC Men's Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026, he smashed 28 sixes, breaking the record for the most sixes in a single match.

articles.title: Israel kills senior Hamas security official in Gaza despite ceasefire
articles.description: Israeli airstrikes have killed several senior Hamas leaders in Gaza, including Naeem Abu Nahel and Samir Abu Younis. The ongoing strikes are part of a series of military operations despite a US-backed ceasefire. Oxfam warns that Israel's military actions have led to severe environmental and humanitarian crises in Gaza. Contaminated water and untreated sewage pose significant health risks to the population.
